name: v26.10.1
body:
## Changes since v26.10.0

### Trident

**Fixes:**

- **Kubernetes:** Fixed Trident node pods force-detaching in-use volumes at startup after upgrading from Trident 25.10 or earlier, which caused pods to fail with `volume ... is not staged`.
